term: complete actual concrete ancestry of a selected existent
definition: Cone m w selected x means that x is concrete and exists at w and is a finite reflexive-transitive actual-concrete-ground ancestor of selected. It includes selected only when selected is actual and concrete. Every actual concrete predecessor of a cone member is included; an observed finite prefix cannot substitute for the cone.
note: General selected-being form of the existing thinker-local vocabulary, reusing Profile, ActualConcreteGround and Mathlib ReflTransGen unchanged. Source-free application hypotheses remain OPEN. See the selected-cone scope section of docs/notes/ultimate-adequacy-integration-735.md.
